title: Choco Coin
description: Fun way for currency in your modpacks/servers using choco coins with a twist.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vfFXVBF4/images/992921f0724880def5f6a88022a8fa664e1dcf6b.png)

Welcome to our little mod, this mod was created for our up and coming modpack as our own take on currency this mod adds a chocolate coins that you can use as a currency but you can put it in a unshaped recipe to open the coin to eat the chocolate, once you do you will be left over the foil, you
can collect these and create a bundle 9 foils to a bundle and then you can cook that bundle to make a foil sheet 9 of them sheets will make a Recycled Foil Block.

## **REMEMBER**: 
You must find a way to give the coins out in your modpack/server making the coin craftable would make the coins usless this is a currency mod where you are able to make the wealth happen.

![Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/435324c92a466c784f082fde0b9c1da61d62028d.png)

Yes we give you blocks in a basic currency mod, but not just that if you want you can then make slabs
stairs, walls and trapdoors(stone cutter) but you can oxidize them with blaze powder there is 2 stages on
all of the blocks BUT you can undo it as well with bone meal. but you must use the blaze powder to get
the other colours of the block.

All recipes can be found it JEI or EMI like recipe mods, we will update recipe images when we can.

## Please Note:
All items here are obtainable in Survival part from the original coin, that is down to the modpack/map maker/server owner to find a means to reward the player with the coin, remember this is a currency for the game. This isn't just plug and play unless your using it in creative to use our blocks.

![all](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vfFXVBF4/images/8b48966517dc16e1ae817abdc38519d01a2c9f98.png)
